tool.name: eScriptorium
tool.description: segment, transcribe and train models on images and PDFs
tool.command: #def stage($datasets, $folder) #for $index, $dataset in enumerate($datasets) #if $dataset #set $name = str($dataset.element_identifier).replace('/', '_').replace("'", '_') #if '.' not in $name #set $name = $name + '.' + str($dataset.ext) #end if #set $target = 'inputs/%s/%04d' % ($folder, $index) mkdir -p '$target' && ln -s '$dataset' '$target/$name' && #end if #end for #end def $stage($images, 'images') $stage($annotations, 'annotations') $stage($segmentation_models, 'segmentation') $stage($recognition_models, 'recognition') exec bash '$__tool_directory__/start.sh'

param.name: images
param.label: Images or PDFs
param.help: Imported as pages in the given order. A list collection keeps its element order.

param.name: annotations
param.label: PAGE or ALTO annotations
param.help: XML files or zip archives, matched to pages by image file name.

tool.help:
Opens eScriptorium with one project and document that contain the selected images and PDF pages. Annotations and models are imported into the same document session.
Exports created in eScriptorium and all models of the session are added to the history when the tool is stopped. Wait for an export to finish before stopping the tool.
